indications.description: Advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma in patients with impaired renal function; reconcile conflicting source renal eligibility before treatment.

treatment.schedule_summary: Gemcitabine 1000 mg/m² and cisplatin 35 mg/m² IV on both days 1 and 8; every 21 days for 4–6 cycles.
treatment.duration_text: Four to six cycles according to response and tolerability

administration.note: Over 60 minutes with hydration on both treatment days.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Highest emetogenic active component and phase-specific NCCP classification.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for high emetogenic risk
premedication: Confirm two cisplatin visits per cycle and how the home anti-sickness courses fit each visit.
other_support: Use one written anti-sickness plan, including medicines before treatment, tablets for home and rescue treatment. Your team reconciles steroids, interactions and any stomach-protection medicine from your local prescription. Cisplatin needs prescribed intravenous fluids and electrolyte monitoring/replacement. Follow your own fluid advice; tell the team about heart failure or fluid restriction. Review kidney function, hearing, nerves and other medicines before treatment. Both day 1 and day 8 contain cisplatin and need their own prescribed support course.
